Description: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.
Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong. Almost all halflings speak Common to converse with the people in whose lands they dwell or through which they are traveling.
Notes: Auto adds Common, Halfling to languages

Description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Notes: Adds Halfling Luck reroll on natural 1s on D20 Tests

Description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Notes: Adds advantage on saves vs the Frightened condition

Description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
Notes: Adds 'move through larger creatures' movement option
